key_insight: R²-PQF enables the T-count savings of probabilistic quantum circuit synthesis by dynamically routing runtime-inserted gates with minimal latency impact.
engineering_relevance: Hardware-accelerated runtime routing helps surface-code quantum computers accommodate dynamic circuits while reducing costly T-state demand.
method: Route gates layer by layer while the previous logical timestep executes.
Use Wavefront Breadth-First Search to find non-intersecting lattice-surgery paths to T-state factories.
Implement routing on a 500 MHz FPGA and a 2 GHz ASIC.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a 1.51 μs median logical timestep for a 300-qubit Ising circuit at 2 GHz, with average execution speedup of 1.34× and up to 1.76× versus a stalling-based baseline.
watch_item: Rare routing-window overruns remain, so median timing does not guarantee every dynamic routing request meets its deadline.
paper_title: Runtime Compilation for Quantum Circuits with PQF-Enabled $R_z$ Synthesis
